meta.title: MSU admissions eligibility rules, January/February 2027 intake (undergraduate and diploma)
meta.source: MSU January/February 2027 intake advert (entry requirements) and the A Level grade scale supplied for this project
meta.o_level_basis: The advert's general requirement: at least 5 O Level passes at grade C or better, including English Language. Programme-specific subjects and grades are added from each programme's text.
assumptions: Subject categories (science, commercial, arts) are an assumption in this file and must be confirmed by the Admissions Office.
Rules are modelled on the main A Level route. Diploma, certificate, employment and mature-entry routes are kept as advertised text and are not decided by grades.
MSU publishes no cut-off points; only Actuarial Science states a points rule (10 points).
Meeting the rules does not guarantee a place. Admission is decided by the Admissions Office.

requirements_as_advertised: At least two passes at Advanced Level ('A' Level) in any A’ Level subjects. A Diploma from the Institute of Bankers; National Diploma (ND) in Business Studies, Accountancy, or Purchasing;

Diploma in Education; Institute of Administration and Commerce (IAC) qualification; Institute of Personnel Management of Zimbabwe (IPMZ) qualification; Diploma in Business Administration (ZIM); Diploma in Marketing; or any other relevant tertiary qualification deemed equivalent.

Mature Entry-Persons who are at least 25 years of age for males and 23 years for females on the first day of the academic year in which admission is sought and who are not eligible for entry under the Normal or Special Entry Regulations may apply for Mature Entry provided that: applicants must have passed at least five approved ‘O’ Level subjects including English Language and Mathematics (where required) or equivalents, and must have demonstrated potential suitability for University studies by virtue of their attainments and/or relevant work experience."

Special Entry-This pathway applies to students wishing to transfer from other universities while enrolled in a Business Management-related degree programme. Such applicants shall be assessed on a case-by-case basis in accordance with the University's transfer policy.

programmes.programme: Bachelor of Engineering Honours Degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering (HEEE)
requirements_as_advertised: 1. For Normal Entry the candidates should have:
(i) Passed at least 5 subjects at Ordinary Level including Mathematics, English and Combined Science or equivalent.
(ii) At least two Advanced Level passes; Mathematics, Physics and any other relevant science subject.
2. For special entry candidates should:
(i) Have passed at least 5 subjects at Ordinary Level including Mathematics, English and Combined Science or equivalent.
(ii) Applicants with a recognized National Certificate or Diploma in a relevant field may be considered using the ZNQF framework starting in year 1 and 2 respectively.
Candidates may be invited for an interview or entrance examination.
